analyses.name: Howmet Aerospace Inc.
analyses.verdict: The cleanest A+ setup in the book — aerospace-parts leader at all-time highs with best-in-class growth; trim into the Aug 6 print.

financials.summary: Another record year driven by the commercial-aerospace up-cycle and engine-spares demand. Revenue grew double digits with meaningful margin expansion as Howmet's engineered structures and fastening systems benefited from Boeing/Airbus rate increases and a rich aftermarket mix; earnings grew far faster than sales on operating leverage.
highlights: EPS up ~+71% YoY on operating leverage
Strong free cash flow funding buybacks + a rising dividend

accomplishments: Rode the commercial-aero recovery to record revenue and margins
Expanded engine-spares and structural-parts share with Boeing/Airbus rate ramps
Consistent capital returns — buybacks and dividend increases

journey_52w.summary: A relentless Stage-2 advance from the low-$170s to a fresh all-time high near $289, with each pullback tighter than the last — a textbook multi-contraction base as institutions accumulated.

milestones.label: Aug 2025
milestones.note: Q2 beat-and-raise on aero demand kicked off the leg higher

milestones.label: Q4 2025
milestones.note: Record full-year results; margin expansion continued

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: New all-time high in a 5-contraction VCP (tightest 2.5%), RS line leading price

risks: Forward P/E ~48 leaves little room for a guide-down
Aug 6 earnings is a binary event — hold size modest into it
A commercial-aero build-rate stumble would hit the whole supply chain
watch: RSI staying above 60 for healthy momentum
Volume confirmation on any breakout extension
critical.valuation: Premium ~48x forward — justified only if the aero up-cycle and margin expansion persist. Quality you pay up for; keep the stop disciplined near $266.

analyses.name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.
analyses.verdict: Premier megabank at all-time highs, still cheap at ~14x — the anchor of the financials leadership.

financials.summary: Record net income on resilient net interest income, a strong markets and investment-banking rebound, and benign credit. JPMorgan's scale and diversification let it out-earn peers through the rate cycle, with book value and capital returns compounding.
highlights: Fortress balance sheet with rising dividend + buybacks

accomplishments: Delivered record annual profit and best-in-class returns
Gained share across investment banking, trading and consumer
Maintained a fortress capital position through the cycle

journey_52w.summary: A steady climb to fresh all-time highs above $350, building a tight 6-contraction base as financials took over market leadership from tech.

milestones.label: 2H 2025
milestones.note: IB/markets rebound and stable NII drove earnings beats

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: New highs in a tight VCP; RS line at new highs

risks: A credit-cycle turn or sharp yield-curve move hits the whole group
This week's Fed decision can whip bank stocks
Capital-markets revenue is cyclical
critical.valuation: ~14x forward for record profitability and a fortress balance sheet is undemanding — the highest-quality large-cap financial at a reasonable price.

analyses.name: Apple Inc.
analyses.verdict: The one mega-cap tech leader still at new highs while peers correct — relative-strength standout.

financials.summary: Record revenue led by a growing high-margin Services business and a solid iPhone cycle. Services now drives the margin story, lifting gross margin to record levels; Apple returned enormous cash via buybacks and dividends while investing in on-device AI.
highlights: Record Services revenue and gross margin

accomplishments: Record Services revenue re-rated the margin profile
Advanced on-device Apple Intelligence / AI features
Continued the largest capital-return program in the market

journey_52w.summary: A grind to fresh all-time highs above $330 that stands out precisely because the rest of big tech (MSFT, ORCL, GOOGL) corrected 20-65% off highs — AAPL's RS line is at new highs.

milestones.label: Fall 2025
milestones.note: Strong iPhone cycle + Services growth drove the leg up

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: New highs, 3-contraction VCP, RS New High while peers lag

risks: ~34x forward is full for a ~high-teens grower
A broad tech de-rating would still pull it lower
China demand and regulatory/antitrust overhangs
catalysts: AI feature adoption driving an upgrade cycle
watch: Whether RS stays at new highs vs peers
critical.valuation: ~34x forward is a premium, but the Services-led margin expansion and unmatched capital returns support it — the market is paying up for durability and relative strength.

analyses.name: Eli Lilly and Company
analyses.verdict: Premier large-cap growth-at-scale — GLP-1 leader with explosive fundamentals, near highs.

financials.summary: A blowout year powered by the incretin/GLP-1 franchise (tirzepatide across diabetes and obesity). Revenue grew more than 50% as capacity ramped to meet demand, and earnings grew even faster on operating leverage — one of the fastest-growing large-caps in the market.

accomplishments: Scaled the GLP-1 franchise to blockbuster status across diabetes and obesity
Expanded manufacturing capacity to chase demand
Advanced a deep incretin + oral-GLP-1 pipeline

journey_52w.summary: A powerful advance toward all-time highs near $1,200 with a 6-contraction base; brief demand/supply and competitive scares were bought, keeping the RS line at new highs.

milestones.note: Successive quarters of 50%+ growth as GLP-1 supply caught up to demand

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: ~3% off highs in a tight 6-contraction VCP, RS New High

risks: ~26x forward on a ~$1,200 stock — high absolute volatility
GLP-1 competition (Novo and orals) and formulary/pricing pressure
Manufacturing-capacity execution
watch: Prescription/scripts trends for the incretin franchise
critical.valuation: ~26x forward is reasonable for 50%+ revenue growth and a structural obesity-market runway — a rare growth-at-scale story trading like quality, not hype.

analyses.name: CVS Health Corporation
analyses.verdict: Cheap defensive-healthcare turnaround leading on relative strength — new highs at ~13x.

financials.summary: A recovery year: the integrated payer (Aetna)–pharmacy–PBM model stabilized as medical-cost pressure eased and cost actions took hold. Revenue grew steadily and earnings rebounded sharply as the turnaround gained traction; cash flow supports the dividend.
highlights: EPS up ~+63% YoY on the turnaround

accomplishments: Reset and stabilized the Aetna medical-cost trend
Executed cost/efficiency actions across the integrated model
Restored earnings momentum after a difficult prior year

journey_52w.summary: A strong recovery from beaten-down levels to a fresh 52-week high with +39% 3-month momentum and an RS line at new highs — a genuine value-to-leadership transition.

milestones.label: 2H 2025
milestones.note: Successive quarters showing MLR stabilization and cost progress

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: New-high VCP, RS New High, momentum leader in healthcare

risks: Medical-loss-ratio (MLR) trend is the key swing variable
Multi-part turnaround execution across payer/PBM/retail
Drug-pricing/PBM regulatory scrutiny
catalysts: Guidance raises as the turnaround compounds
critical.valuation: ~13x forward for a stabilizing integrated healthcare giant is inexpensive — the re-rating has room if the MLR trend keeps improving.

analyses.name: Dell Technologies Inc.
analyses.verdict: The AI-server monster still working — explosive momentum and earnings at a reasonable ~20x.

financials.summary: AI-optimized server demand (ISG) drove a step-change year: revenue surged on record AI-server shipments and backlog, and earnings grew even faster. The client (PC) business stabilized, but the story is the Infrastructure Solutions Group riding the AI-datacenter build-out.

accomplishments: Became a primary beneficiary of the AI-server build-out
Built a large AI-server backlog with hyperscaler/enterprise demand
Grew earnings faster than revenue on mix and scale

journey_52w.summary: A +103% three-month surge on AI-server demand carried Dell to within ~6% of its high — one of very few AI-levered names still in a clear uptrend while semis corrected.

milestones.note: Successive quarters of record AI-server revenue and rising backlog

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: Near highs with +103% 3-month momentum while most tech corrected

risks: AI-server mix is lower-margin — margin quality vs. the revenue hype
AI-capex-digestion cycle could slow order growth
Customer concentration among a few hyperscalers
critical.valuation: ~20x forward for ~triple-digit AI-server growth is reasonable — the debate is durability and margin, not price.

analyses.name: Kimco Realty Corporation
analyses.verdict: Grocery-anchored REIT breaking to new highs — the defensive rate-sensitive leadership working now.

financials.summary: Steady FFO growth from a grocery-anchored open-air portfolio with high occupancy and positive leasing spreads. Kimco's necessity-based tenant mix delivered resilient, growing cash flow that funds a well-covered dividend.
highlights: High occupancy with positive leasing spreads

accomplishments: Maintained high occupancy and pricing power in open-air retail
Grew FFO on positive re-leasing spreads
Continued portfolio quality upgrades

journey_52w.summary: A rate-driven advance to fresh highs near $26 as yields eased and money rotated into quality REITs; a tight 3-contraction base with RS at new highs.

milestones.label: 2H 2025
milestones.note: Occupancy and leasing spreads drove steady FFO

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: New highs in a tight VCP, RS New High as REITs led

risks: Long-duration — a renewed yield spike is the main threat
Retail-tenant credit softness in a consumer slowdown
Cap-rate sensitivity on the portfolio
critical.valuation: ~30x FFO reflects quality and the rate tailwind — reasonable for a best-in-class grocery-anchored REIT if yields keep easing.

analyses.name: MetLife, Inc.
analyses.verdict: Cheap, high-quality insurer at all-time highs — single-digit P/E with a rate tailwind.

financials.summary: Higher-for-longer rates lifted net investment income on MetLife's large float, while group benefits and international delivered steady results. Earnings grew solidly and capital returns (buybacks + dividend) continued, all at a valuation well below the market.
highlights: Net investment income boosted by higher rates

accomplishments: Capitalized on higher rates to grow investment income
Delivered steady group-benefits and international results
Sustained shareholder returns at a low valuation

journey_52w.summary: A methodical climb to all-time highs near $95 in a tight VCP with RS at new highs — classic risk-off leadership as investors favored cheap, rate-levered insurers.

milestones.note: Rate-driven investment income supported earnings growth

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: New highs, tight VCP, RS New High

risks: Fed rate cuts would compress the investment-income tailwind
Credit/spread widening hits the investment portfolio
Long-tail insurance reserve risk
critical.valuation: ~9x forward is cheap for a quality insurer with a rate tailwind — value plus momentum, exactly what this tape rewards.

analyses.name: Crocs, Inc.
analyses.verdict: Deep-value consumer breakout at ~9x — RS New High with strong momentum, though growth is flattish.

financials.summary: A high-free-cash-flow footwear business: the core Crocs brand stayed resilient with strong margins while HeyDude was the soft spot. Revenue and EPS were roughly flat, but robust FCF funded aggressive buybacks and debt reduction — the setup for a valuation re-rating.
highlights: Strong operating margin and free cash flow

accomplishments: Sustained high margins on the core Crocs brand
Generated strong FCF used for buybacks and deleveraging
Kept the balance sheet improving despite HeyDude softness

journey_52w.summary: A recovery from washed-out, single-digit-multiple levels to a fresh high near $135 with +32% 3-month momentum and RS at new highs — a valuation re-rating more than a growth surge.

milestones.label: 2H 2025
milestones.note: FCF and buybacks drove a re-rating off depressed levels

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: New highs, 6-contraction VCP, RS New High

risks: EPS/revenue roughly flat — momentum is a re-rating, not growth
HeyDude brand weakness and inventory risk
Discretionary-spend sensitivity in a slowdown
catalysts: Continued buybacks shrinking the share count
watch: Guidance for a return to growth
critical.valuation: ~9x forward with strong FCF is deep value — the re-rating has room if the top line even stabilizes; the flat growth is the honest caveat.

analyses.name: SpaceX (new listing)
analyses.verdict: NEW LISTING — thesis-led speculative WATCH; the defining space franchise, but down hard post-IPO with no TV rating yet.

financials.period: Recent IPO — limited public financial history
financials.summary: As a very recent listing, SpaceX has limited standardized public financials. The investable story is Starlink (satellite-internet subscribers and revenue scaling toward the majority of the business), dominant global launch share via reusable Falcon, and the Starship program targeting far lower cost-to-orbit. Treat reported figures cautiously until multiple public fiscal periods exist.
highlights: Starlink subscriber/revenue ramp is the core financial driver
Heavy reinvestment into Starship — near-term profitability is secondary to growth
Financial disclosures still thin as a new listing

accomplishments: Scaled Starlink to a large global subscriber base
Maintained dominant reusable-launch cadence and market share
Progressed Starship toward operational flights

journey_52w.summary: IPO momentum drove an early spike, followed by a sharp ~46% drawdown from the post-listing high amid broad risk-off pressure on speculative/space names — now trying to stabilize near $115.

milestones.label: IPO
milestones.note: Listed to strong initial demand and an early momentum peak

milestones.label: Jul 2026
milestones.note: ~46% off the post-IPO high; weak momentum, no TradingView rating yet (normal for a new listing)

risks: NEW LISTING: thin history, no TV rating, extreme volatility
Down ~46% from its IPO high — no technical base yet
Narrative-driven valuation; lock-up/dilution and Starship execution risk
catalysts: New public financial disclosures that de-risk the story
watch: Whether the stock can build a base and stop making lower lows
critical.valuation: Story stock, not a quant setup — valuation is narrative-driven on Starlink's scale and Starship optionality. Accumulate small on stabilization, not on the current downtrend.
